"""Refund settlement: decides where a refund goes (card, store credit, gift card), talks to the
payment provider, books the ledger entry and records what happened.

payments.refunds.refund() only validates the amount against what was captured; this module is what
the admin "Refund" button and the returns flow call."""

def _proportion(req: RefundRequest, part_cents: int) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    """Split part_cents across goods/tax/shipping in the request's proportions (remainder to goods)."""
    tax = req.tax_cents * part_cents // req.total_cents
    ship = req.shipping_cents * part_cents // req.total_cents
    return part_cents - tax - ship, tax, ship

MON = datetime(2026, 3, 9, 9, 0)


def test_ticket_flow_threads_and_reopens():
    desk = Desk(EventBus())
    t = desk.open("Where is ord_0123456789ab?", "Still not here", MON, customer_id="C1")
    assert t.order_id == "ord_0123456789ab"
    desk.reply(t.id, "ann", "Checking", MON + timedelta(hours=1))
    assert t.status == PENDING_CUSTOMER and t.first_response_at == MON + timedelta(hours=1)
    desk.customer_email(t.id, "Re", "Thanks", MON + timedelta(hours=2))
    assert t.status == OPEN
    desk.reply(t.id, "ann", "Sent again", MON + timedelta(hours=3), solve=True)
    late = desk.customer_email(t.id, "Re", "Broken now", MON + timedelta(days=10))
    assert late.id != t.id and f"follow_up:{t.id}" in late.tags
    assert desk.close_solved(MON + timedelta(days=5)) == [t.id]
    with pytest.raises(TicketClosed):
        desk.reply(t.id, "ann", "x", MON + timedelta(days=6))


def test_business_minutes_skip_nights_and_weekends():
    fri_5pm = datetime(2026, 3, 13, 17, 0)
    assert business_minutes(fri_5pm, datetime(2026, 3, 16, 9, 0)) == 120
    assert add_business_minutes(fri_5pm, 90) == datetime(2026, 3, 16, 8, 30)
    assert add_business_minutes(datetime(2026, 3, 14, 12), 10) == datetime(2026, 3, 16, 8, 10)


def test_sla_breaches_ignore_time_waiting_for_customer():
    desk = Desk(EventBus())
    t = desk.open("Help", "x", MON)
    t.priority = "urgent"
    assert first_response_due(t) == MON + timedelta(hours=1)
    assert breached(t, MON + timedelta(hours=2)) == ["first_response"]
    desk.reply(t.id, "ann", "need info", MON + timedelta(minutes=30))
    assert breached(t, MON + timedelta(days=3)) == []


def test_routing_and_macros():
    desk = Desk(EventBus())
    t = route(desk.open("Charged twice", "I want my money back or I call my lawyer", MON))

    t2 = route(desk.open("Hello", "tracking please", MON), tier="gold")
    assert t2.queue == "shipping" and t2.priority == "high"

+def refund_destinations(order_id: str, amount_cents: int, payments: list[Payment], today: date) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Calculate exact destination split for a refund of amount_cents on order_id.
+
+    Returns a dict with keys "card", "store_credit", and "gift_card" indicating
+    how many cents go to each destination.
+    Does not perform any refunds.
+    """
+    if amount_cents <= 0:
+        return {"card": 0, "store_credit": 0, "gift_card": 0}
+
+    captured = [p for p in payments if p.order_id == order_id and p.status == CAPTURED]
+    if not captured:
+        return {"card": 0, "store_credit": 0, "gift_card": 0}
+
+    ordered = sorted(captured, key=lambda p: (p.method == "gift_card", p.created))
+    weights = [p.refundable_cents for p in ordered]
+    total_weight = sum(weights)
+    if total_weight <= 0:
+        return {"card": 0, "store_credit": 0, "gift_card": 0}
+
+    shares = []
+    for w in weights:
+        shares.append(amount_cents * w // total_weight)
+    leftover = amount_cents - sum(shares)
+    for i, p in enumerate(ordered):
+        if leftover <= 0:
+            break
+        room = p.refundable_cents - shares[i]
+        give = min(room, leftover)
+        shares[i] += give

+    to_card = 0

+    to_gift_card = 0

+        else:

+        "store_credit": to_store_credit,
